lede: Oregon State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +2.5 against -10.9, a 13.4-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Colorado State +1.4 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Oregon State winning 54% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 79% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
